question: What does motor vehicle insurance sti say concerning "If you have submitted a written application (or any other"?
answer:
If you have submitted a written application (or any other text form) to the insurance provider, you will have provisional cover in the business lines you have applied for from the date when the vehicle is registered. This provisional cover will end upon the acceptance of the contract or, in the event of rejection, 3 days after you receive the declaration of rejection. You will be liable for the part of the premium covering the time until insurance cover expires. This also applies if you apply for a change in your insurance cover. 

Source: [motor-vehicle-insurance-sti.pdf, page 6]

question: How does motor vehicle insurance sti describe "4 Costs for psychological support The insured person is entitled"?
answer:
The motor vehicle insurance STI describes costs for psychological support as follows:

- The insured person is entitled to support and psychological counseling if it is required as a result of an insured event under this contract.
- Benefits cover 3 calls, with a maximum amount equivalent to CHF 1,000, applicable per insured person per event.
- Support or counseling is provided by the Carelink foundation.
- Medical services, as well as excesses and deductibles under Swiss social insurance schemes, are not insured.

Source: [motor-vehicle-insurance-sti.pdf, page 29]

question: What does motor vehicle insurance sti say concerning "As soon as the policyholder has received notice of acceptance"?
answer:
Motor vehicle insurance STI states that as soon as the policyholder has received notice of acceptance, the insurance is deemed concluded. The policyholder shall be provided with their policy as proof of the conclusion of the insurance. Insurance cover starts on the commencement date given in the policy, unless a confirmation of cover in text form was issued for an earlier date. 

Source: [motor-vehicle-insurance-sti.pdf, page 5]
